statement.p: Suppose N = f(t) is the total number of inches of snow that fall in the first t days of January.
Which of the statements below best explains the meaning of the INVERSE function f^{-1}?

li.p: The number of inches of snow accumulated in t days
The number of inches of snow on the ground after t days
The days for which there are N inches of snow on the ground
The number of days it takes to accumulate N inches of snow

static.solution:
SOLUTION
The inverse function gives the number of days in January until N inches of snow have fallen.
